ui.chat.session_readout.access.absent.de: The serving device has no effective provider access for this session. Connect an account or choose another model.
The device running this session has no effective provider access. Sign in or restore access on that device, or choose another model.
ui.chat.session_readout.access.device_bo: This login cannot be borrowed. Sign in on the device running this session, or choose another model.
ui.chat.session_readout.access.effective: The runtime resolved borrowed access for this session. Every new request checks the owner again.
ui.chat.session_readout.access.eligible_: This session may borrow {label} access, but it has not resolved it yet. The next request verifies {owner} automatically.
ui.chat.session_readout.access.expired.d: The last borrowed grant expired, but borrowing permission is still present. The next request asks {owner} for fresh access automatically.
ui.chat.session_readout.access.history.o: History only; not permission to reuse access.
ui.chat.session_readout.access.local.des: This session uses its own provider access.
ui.chat.session_readout.access.owner_una: This session could not resolve {label} access from {owner}. Previous access cannot be reused. Retry after owner access is restored, or choose another model.
ui.chat.session_readout.access.pending.d: Access has not converged yet. The next request checks the owner automatically; no additional sign-in is needed here.
ui.chat.session_readout.access.withdrawn: The owner cannot currently provide borrowed access, or borrowing permission is unavailable. Restore owner access or permission before retrying, or choose another model.
ui.chat.session_readout.draft.confirm_ef: This conversation will run {selector}. Its effort is now {level}, because {wanted} is not one of that model's levels.
This conversation will run {selector}. No effort level is set on it, because {wanted} is not one of that model's levels.
ui.chat.session_readout.draft.confirm_mo: This conversation will run {selector} at {effort} effort.
ui.chat.session_readout.draft.refusal_la: Nothing was changed, because that model's effort levels could not be read. Try again.
ui.chat.session_readout.effort.detail.au: No level is set, so this model runs at its own default. It offers {levels}.
No level is set, so this model runs at its own default ({default}). It offers {levels}.
ui.chat.session_readout.effort.detail.de: The level this model runs at by default. This backend does not report which other levels it accepts.
ui.chat.session_readout.effort.detail.no: This model reasons, but exposes no effort levels to choose between.
This session has not reported its reasoning effort yet. It appears after the next turn, or run {command} to set one now.
ui.chat.session_readout.strip.draft_fail: No model is set for it yet
This conversation's model was not resolved
ui.chat.session_readout.strip.draft_pend: Working out which model this conversation will run on
ui.chat.session_readout.strip.model_swit: Switching the model; waiting for the session to confirm it
ui.chat.session_readout.strip.readings_d: Readings dropped when the connection was lost.
